description: Ten original biome-specific shattered shell ground albedos. Damage blending is anchored to Wound distance in the renderer.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original high-resolution Wound-edge ground albedo texture for The Sphere Observatory. Create ONE square 2048x2048 image, a seamlessable orthographic straight-down material covering a 2.5 kilometre patch of the shattered inner surface of an ancient artificial world. Ruined engineered shell is the dominant substrate: fractured construction slabs, collapsed service grids, exposed foundation layers, torn metal, fine angular rubble and local debris. This is the ground adjoining a catastrophic Wound, not a picture of a cliff or a horizon. Fill the entire square with tangible ground; no cutaway, no sky, no space, no hole or black void at an image edge. Many irregularly distributed fine details, broad subdued variations, no central focal object, no repeated lattice or perfect symmetry. Uniform flat diffuse illumination suitable for an albedo map, no directional cast shadows, no gloss highlights, no fog, no text, no borders, no labels. Retain rich photorealistic detail without baked lighting. Biome-specific design: Dark Age Forest. Muted pine-green moss in crevices, broken root networks, windthrown ancient conifer trunks, deep brown forest soil between grey shattered slabs, crushed dark canopy remnants. The old construction remains clearly dominant and readable. Vegetation is sparse and battered, not an intact forest.

Change only the fungal organic remains in Image 1 to match the cyan-teal, pale mint fibrous networks and crushed blue-teal disc-shaped fungal crowns in Image 2. Keep Image 1's exact shattered grey foundation layout, scale, detailed fine rubble, buried service conduits, orthographic overhead composition, flat diffuse illumination and catastrophic damage. Do not copy the intact landscape from Image 2. The outcome remains dominated by exposed ruined grey construction interwoven with severely damaged cyan-teal fungal remnants. No grass or forest vegetation, no neon glow, no text, no border, no horizon. One square albedo image at the same resolution as Image 1.
